The material package and live mutation-admission receipt therefore had no legal producing path for the first selected unit.
affected_invariant: A selected unit may enter exactly one strict Context Builder path without gaining mutation authority; every mutation must still require the current material package, producer receipt, exact target baselines, selection binding, live mutation admission, and single-use receipt consumption.

Implementation Readiness emits it only after validating the audited plan, exact selection receipt, execution-intent binding, unit digest, and unique Task Session route. The Task Session guard may then enter Context Builder with zero mutations. The existing governance runner recognizes the matching context-ready receipt but continues to require the unchanged plan-once mutation-admission and baseline checks before executor launch.
